name: api
description: - les dossiers en `kebab-case` - les fichiers en `camelCase`

scripts.db:reset: docker compose exec -T db sh -c 'psql -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "SET client_min_messages TO warning" -c "DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE" -c "CREATE SCHEMA public" -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-schema.sql -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02-seed.sql && echo Base remise à zéro.'
